title: Microsoft 365 Email Authentication — SPF, DKIM & DMARC
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Exchange/M365 messaging operations).

Exchange admin center / M365 admin center / Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph and on-prem Exchange Server + AD authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; version-/plan-dependent behavior (Exchange Server CU, EOP vs Defender for Office 365 plan, EOA/auto-expanding archive availability, Commercial vs Government cloud) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant/version', never invented. Third-party hygiene/archiving/gateway tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell (EXO PowerShell / Graph) — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Authenticate your Microsoft 365 mail and stop domain spoofing
problem: If your domain isn't authenticated, attackers spoof it and your legitimate mail lands in spam. This solution implements email authentication for Microsoft 365: publish and scope SPF, enable DKIM signing in Exchange Online (and for on-prem/hybrid senders), and roll DMARC from monitor to enforcement (p=none → quarantine → reject) using aggregate reports — plus alignment for third-party senders — so your domain is protected and deliverable.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — SPF/DKIM/DMARC and alignment, the EXO DKIM model, third-party sender handling, and the monitor→enforce journey.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (EXO + accepted domains, DNS control, inventory of legitimate senders, admin roles).

Implementation Guide — inventory senders, publish/scope SPF, enable DKIM signing, publish DMARC at p=none, review aggregate reports, then move to quarantine and reject — pilot-first, without breaking legitimate senders.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (SPF/DKIM pass, DMARC aligned, reports reviewed before enforcement) plus Best Practices for safely reaching p=reject.
short: Implement SPF, DKIM & DMARC for Microsoft 365 — scope SPF, enable EXO DKIM signing, roll DMARC monitor→quarantine→reject on aggregate reports, and align third-party senders — so your domain can't be spoofed and stays deliverable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
